review_type: direct ZIP/XML and sidecar JSON audit; no production policy, adapter or service output used to establish gold
method: Parsed all 24 original XLSX worksheet XML files with stdlib; checked all 960 five-cell rows and authority records against source specification.
Recomputed every workbook/sidecar SHA-256 and verified runtime and evaluation manifest hashes.
Independently assessed each query from documented approval, inclusive start/exclusive end, supersession, scope, distinct line identity and Decimal arithmetic.
Read existing quantity assessment solely to confirm exact missing_observation reason after future assertion exclusion; no policy functions executed for labels.
Confirmed 48 query/gold/qrel identities and 3/3/2/2/2 category denominators per project, project split membership and complete item source inventories.
Independently compared all 232 source_rows.authority_record expectations to exact original sidecar records after the evaluator correction; all matched.

findings.finding: Legal JSON [] at the response boundary raises uncaught AttributeError and aborts evaluation rather than retaining one unknown result and continuing.
findings.counterexample: Mock _fetch to return (200, []); evaluate raises AttributeError.
findings.corrective_direction: Validate response and nested evidence/source shapes and preserve each failed query in the final report.
findings.resolution: Response shape validation retains null/array/null-entry payloads as 48 unknown results; malformed nested scalar artifact_id is caught per query as unknown and does not abort. Original and residual attacks rerun successfully.

findings.finding: Source support validation admits wrong locators and missing authority records.
findings.counterexample: Atlas mismatch scores pass/ready true when every source authority record is replaced by {}. score_response returns no errors with WrongSheet/B-row quantity locators and wrong authority collection.
findings.corrective_direction: Validate exact evidence locator and source authority record content against frozen original artifacts, not just document descriptor and self-reported digest.
findings.resolution: Scoring now pins BOM sheet/columns and records collection; source checking compares complete authority record and project/artifact/role/tenant/site descriptor. Empty records, foreign tenant/site, and incorrect locator attacks are rejected.

runtime_review.cross_item_identity: Reviewed whole scoped inventory ownership scan before item filtering; conflicting line/assertion owner raises admission failure.
runtime_review.source_lookup: source_by_id authorizes evidence permission then performs exactly one fresh _admit per request; HTTP no longer does separate inventory admission.
runtime_review.order_policy: No new replacement policy: adapter still rejects PO expiry/supersession; application uses established distinct lines and assertion reconciliation.
runtime_review.runtime_gold_separation: Source/package configuration has no runtime gold imports or oracle labels; package smoke denylist now includes pilot-gold.json and pilot-gold-review.json. Parent owns fresh installed-wheel verification; no clean artifact pass is claimed by this audit.

limitations: This independent agent audit is not external procurement expert certification.
G1 uses author-supplied structured requests; natural-language interpretation and retrieval are not evaluated.
Public development-held-out splits share renderer and scenario ancestry; no blind or contamination-proof claim.
Original Atlas gold remains a 12-case regression; it is not substituted for the 48-case audit.
Final package/browser/full-suite acceptance is outside this audit and must remain separately evidenced.

verification.command: python3 /tmp/pilot-independent-audit.py plus direct sidecar equality checks
verification.result: 48 gold cases accepted; 960 original rows and authority records verified; 232 new authority expectations equal source records

verification.command: Independent evaluator _fetch mutation probes with original corpus_response and frozen gold (not used to derive gold)
verification.result: Empty authority record and wrong tenant/site: fail; numeric artifact_id: unknown with retained result; null/array/null evidence entry: all 48 unknown; wrong sheet/columns/collection: rejected.

boundary_review.empty_missing: Pilot missing observations retain null ordered quantity and missing_observation; original Atlas no-requirement case remains regression.
boundary_review.multiplicity: Independent line totals, exact assertion replay, conflicting duplicate and cross-item ownership tests reviewed; ownership checked before item filtering.
boundary_review.scope_time: Project-isolated identical SKU, unauthorized request, cross-project source denial, future approval, exact approval and original effective interval boundaries reviewed.
boundary_review.numeric: Zero and fractional pilot values verified with Decimal; admission rejects negative and NaN; incompatible units abstain.
boundary_review.source_integrity: All source hashes/coordinates/sidecar records independently verified; corruption/path/schema/scope checks and once-per-request fresh admission reviewed.
boundary_review.public_artifact: Focused HTTP tests pass; full 48-case live HTTP scoring, browser, and clean installation acceptance are parent-owned separate gates.
boundary_review.failure_accounting: All independently probed malformed response and unsupported source-support variants remain fail/unknown and cannot produce ready=true.
boundary_review.policy_restraint: PO replacement/expiry remain unsupported; BOM authority uses prior policy and missing observations never imply missing PO or zero.

readiness_claim: Independent gold and code review accepted for recorded input/code hashes; no main, merge, deployment, browser, full-suite or installed-package completion claim.
